Load cohort parquet into Postgres

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_db.Rd

Validates the accepted manifest-backed cohort artifact, loads and validates it in a run-specific staging schema, builds the selected release's indexes, and transactionally promotes the complete schema. A failed load, validation, or index phase leaves the prior raw schema in place. Run build_window_tables() and optionally build_cohort_annotations() afterwards to add lookup and derived tables.

Usage

run_db(
  src_name,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  delete_source_parquet = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  unlogged = FALSE,
  set_logged = FALSE,
  synchronous_commit_off = FALSE,
  engine = c("postgres", "duckdb"),
  db_path = NULL,
  create_indexes = TRUE,
  loading = NULL,
  execution = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name.

db_name

Optional Postgres database name. If NULL, uses the active project config, then "rendehr".

base_dir

Project root directory.

delete_source_parquet

Delete each parquet file after it is successfully loaded into Postgres. Default FALSE.

overwrite

If FALSE (default), a manifest-complete existing raw schema is retained and any missing indexes are resumed idempotently. Otherwise a complete replacement is built in staging. If TRUE, always build and validate a fresh staged replacement.

unlogged

If TRUE, load into UNLOGGED tables for speed. Much faster, but UNLOGGED tables are emptied on an unclean shutdown and are not replicated - safe here only because the raw tables are reproducible from the cohort parquet. Default FALSE. Use set_logged = TRUE to restore durability after.

set_logged

If TRUE (with unlogged = TRUE), convert tables back to durable LOGGED after each loads (rewrites the table). Default FALSE.

synchronous_commit_off

If TRUE, set synchronous_commit = off for the load session (restored afterwards) to speed bulk loading. Default FALSE.

engine

Storage backend: "postgres" (default) or "duckdb". With "duckdb" the cohort parquet is loaded into a single .duckdb file via run_db_duckdb(); db_name and the Postgres-only tuning flags are ignored. run_one_source(engine = "duckdb") uses this path and then extracts the concepts in the same DuckDB file; harmonization stays PostgreSQL-only.

db_path

DuckDB file path (only used when engine = "duckdb"). Default uses paths.duckdb_root (data/duckdb by default) plus {src_name}.duckdb.

create_indexes

Build the bundled post-load indexes before promotion? Default TRUE. Set FALSE to explicitly defer the potentially expensive step. Existing complete schemas resume the idempotent index phase.

loading

Optional overrides from loading_options() or a named list.

execution

Optional overrides from execution_options() or a named list.

Value

Invisibly, a list containing aggregate load, validation, and index reports for PostgreSQL, or the DuckDB load report.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run_db("mimic_iv_demo", db_name = "rendehr")
} # }
